title: When he stopped travelling as a bandleader
summary: Fields says his last year as a travelling bandleader was about 1965 and that he then took society dates near home.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Well, I would consider that was about the last year that I travelled anywhere, calling myself a bandleader. Of course, along about that time, I might have gone a little longer, but we were considered--and I have a picture of that, with Woody Herman.
What you're looking at now, that's when maybe I kind of went on society type dates at home. I didn't travel. I'll show you the one I'm talking about.
